Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:10:1.hebrew: בעדות בכור - תנן בבכורות (דף לה.): כל מומין הראויין לבא בידי אדם, רועים כהנים אין נאמנין לומר: "מאליו נפל בו מום זה", לפי שנחשדו כהנים להטיל מומין בבכורות בזמן הזה כדי להתירן בשחיטה. ואם הביא בכור להראותו לחכם — צריך שני עדים עמו שמאליו נפל בו מום זה; אם הביא עד אחד על מום זה ועד אחד על מום אחר בבכור זה — מצטרפין. ואית דאמרי: בעדות בכור — להעיד שהתירו חכם. ולאו מילתא היא, דהא חד נאמן, דעד אחד נאמן באיסורין, ואפילו כהן שהוא בעליו נאמן, דתנן (שם דף לו.): נאמן הכהן לומר: "הראיתי בכור זה ובעל מום הוא", דמילתא דעבידא לאיגלויי — לא משקר:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:10:1.english: With regard to testimony concerning a firstborn - We learned in a Mishnah in Bekhorot (35a): [Regarding] all blemishes that are capable of being caused by human hands, priestly shepherds are not believed to say, "This blemish occurred on its own," because priests are suspected of inflicting blemishes on firstborn animals in this era in order to permit them for slaughter. And if he brought a firstborn to show it to a Sage, he requires two witnesses with him [to testify] that this blemish occurred on its own; [and] if he brought one witness concerning this blemish and one witness concerning another blemish on this [same] firstborn, they join together. And there are those who say: "With regard to testimony concerning a firstborn" [means] to testify that a Sage permitted it. But this is not correct, for [even] one [witness] is believed, as one witness is believed regarding [matters of ritual] prohibition, and even a priest who is its owner is believed, as we learned in a Mishnah (there, 36a): "A priest is believed to say: 'I showed this firstborn [to an expert] and it is a blemished animal,'" for [regarding] a matter that is bound to be revealed, [a person] does not lie.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:10:2.hebrew: ובעדות חזקה - זה אומר: "בפני אכלה שלש שנים ראשונות של שמיטה", וזה אומר: "בפני אכלה שלש שנים אחרונות" — מצטרפי, דאחד קרקע מסהדי חזקה מעלייתא:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:10:2.english: And with regard to testimony concerning presumptive ownership - This [witness] says: “In my presence he consumed [its produce for the] first three years of the Sabbatical cycle,” and that [witness] says: “In my presence he consumed [it for the] last three years” — they combine, for they testify about one [and the same piece of] land [establishing] a valid presumptive ownership.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:10:3.hebrew: וכן - לענין שתי שערות שבבן ושבבת. וכי פליגי, בהלוואת מנה פליגי, משום דלאו אחד מנה קמסהדי:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:10:3.english: And so - With regard to the two hairs of a boy and of a girl. And when they disagree, they disagree regarding the loan of a maneh, because they are not testifying about one [and the same] maneh.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:11:1.hebrew: גברא אגברא - רבי אבא ור' אידי אדעולא:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:11:1.english: [One] man against [another] man - [You are setting] Rabbi Abba and Rav Idi against [the statement of] Ulla.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:12:2.hebrew: חצי דבר וחצי עדות - עד א' הוא חצי עדות, שיער אחת הוא חצי דבר:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:12:2.english: Half a matter and half a testimony - One witness is half a testimony, [and] one hair is half a matter.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:13:1.english: Rather, one says two [hairs] on her back - For both of them testify that she is an adult.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:14:1.hebrew: בקרקעות אבל לא במטלטלין - הלכה כמותו, דלא בעינן דחזו תרווייהו כחד בקרקעות — משום דכי מסהדי בבי דינא, תרווייהו ידעי דאחדא מילתא מסהדי, וקרינא ביה "והוא עד", ואע"ג דבשעתא דחזי לא ידע [חד] בחבריה. אבל לא במטלטלין — דכי מסהדי קמן, לאו אחד מנה מסהדי:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:14:1.english: With regard to land, but not with regard to movable property - The halakha is in accordance with his opinion, that we do not require that both of them saw [the incident] together in [cases of] land, because when they testify in court, both of them know that they are testifying about one [and the same] matter, and we apply to him [the verse]: “And he is a witness” (Leviticus 5:1), even though at the time that he saw [it], [one] did not know about his fellow [witness]. But [it is] not [so] with regard to movable property, because when they testify before us, they are not testifying about one [and the same] maneh.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:15:1.hebrew: רב - דאמר: ״אבל לא במטלטלין״, משום דלאו בחד מנה מסהדי:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:15:1.english: Rav - Who said: “But not with regard to movable property” — [this is] because they are not testifying about one [and the same] maneh.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:15:2.hebrew: לטעמיה דאמר רב הודאה אחר הודאה - זה אומר: "בפני הודה לו על מנה באחד בשבת", וזה אומר: "בפני הודה לו עליו בשני בשבת":
Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:15:2.english: [Rav] conforms to his line of reasoning, as Rav says: An admission following an admission - This one says: "In my presence he admitted to him regarding a maneh on the first day of the week," and that one says: "In my presence he admitted to him regarding it on the second day of the week."

Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:15:3.hebrew: הודאה אחר הלואה - זה אומר: בפני הלוהו מנה באחד בשבת, וזה אומר: בפני הודה לו מנה בשני בשבת:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:15:3.english: An admission following a loan - This [witness] says: In my presence he lent him a maneh on the first day of the week, and that [witness] says: In my presence he admitted to him [that he owes him] a maneh on the second day of the week.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:15:4.hebrew: מצטרפי - דאיכא למימר בחד מנה קמסהדי, וכדמוקי לקמן:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:15:4.english: Are combined - For it can be said that they are testifying about one [and the same] maneh, and as [the Gemara] establishes below.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:16:1.hebrew: הלואה אחר הודאה - מנה אחרינא הוא, ולא מצטרפי, אע"ג דתרווייהו אמרי שחייב לו מנה:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:16:1.english: A loan following an admission - It is a different maneh, and [the testimonies] do not combine, even though both of them say that he owes him a maneh.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:17:1.hebrew: הודאה אחר הודאה נמי - דילמא מנה דאודי ליה קמי האי, לאו היינו מנה דאודי ליה קמי האי:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:17:1.english: An admission following an admission as well - Perhaps the maneh that he admitted to him in the presence of this [witness] is not the [same] maneh that he admitted to him in the presence of that [witness].

Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:19:1.hebrew: ואכתי בתרא ידע - דאמנה דקא מסהיד איהו, מסהיד אידך; אבל קמא לא ידע דאחד מנה קמסהדי. הלכך, לא קרינא ביה "והוא עד", דמשמע תרווייהו כחד:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:19:1.english: And still, the last [witness] knows - That regarding the *maneh* about which he is testifying, the other [witness] is [also] testifying; but the first [witness] does not know that they are testifying about one [and the same] *maneh*. Therefore, we cannot apply to it [the verse]: “And he is a witness” (Leviticus 5:1), which implies [that] both of them [must be] as one.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:1:1.hebrew: ודכולי עלמא - תנא קמא ור' נתן:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:1:1.english: And everyone - The first tanna and Rabbi Natan.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:1:2.hebrew: כרבנן דפליגי אדר' יהושע בן קרחה - סבירא להו, דאמרי: בעינן שיראו שנים כאחד, וילפינן טעמא מוהוא עד — דליחזי כחד. וגבי הגדה, פליגי תנאי דסיפא באקושיה הגדה לראיה, כדכתיב (ויקרא ה׳:א׳) או ראה אם לא יגיד — בחד קרא:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:1:2.english: In accordance with the Rabbis who disagree with Rabbi Yehoshua ben Korḥa - They hold [in accordance with them], as they say: We require that two [witnesses] see [the incident] as one, and we derive the reason from “and he is a witness” — that they must see [it] as one. And with regard to testimony, the tanna’im of the latter clause disagree over juxtaposing testimony to seeing, as it is written (Leviticus 5:1): “Whether he has seen... if he does not utter it” — in a single verse.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:21:1.hebrew: לאו היינו הודאה אחר הלואה - כיון דבעינן דידע סהדא בחבריה, על כרחיך הודאה אחר הלואה נמי הכי מוקמת לה: דאמר ליה לבתרא, "מנה דמודינא קמך יזיפי קמי פלניא", והדר אמר ליה לקמא, "מנה דיזיפי קמך אודאי ליה קמי פלניא". ותרתי למה לי לרב למימר:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:21:1.english: Isn't this [the same as] an admission following a loan - Since we require that [each] witness know of his fellow [witness], perforce you must establish [the case of] an admission following a loan in this manner as well: that he said to the latter [witness], “The maneh that I admit [to owing] in your presence, I borrowed in the presence of so-and-so,” and then he said to the first [witness], “The maneh that I borrowed in your presence, I admitted [to owing] in the presence of so-and-so.” And why did Rav need to state both [cases]?

Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:22:1.english: This is what I heard - About the people of your city.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:22:2.hebrew: דרמיתו דיקלי וזקפיתו ליה - שאתם משונים, קוצצין דקלים וחוזרין ונוטעין אותן — כלומר, בונים וסותרים — שפירשתם לי קושיא, וחזרתם וסתרתם:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:22:2.english: That you knock down palm trees and erect [them] - That you are peculiar: cutting down palm trees and then planting them again — that is to say, building and tearing down — for you resolved a difficulty for me, and then went back and tore [it] down.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:23:1.hebrew: מצטרפין - דמ"מ, הן מעידין שחייב לו מנה:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:23:1.english: Are combined - For in any case, they testify that he owes him a maneh.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:24:1.hebrew: בבדיקות - שאינה משבע חקירות — באיזו יום, באיזו שעה — שהזמה תלויה בהן; אבל בכליו שחורין וכליו לבנים, שאין דין הזמה תלויה בהן:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:24:1.english: In examinations - That [the contradiction] is not in [one of] the seven inquiries — on which day [or] in which hour — upon which hazamah [refutation by alibi] depends; but [rather, such as where one said] his garments were black and [the other said] his garments were white, upon which the law of hazamah does not depend.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:25:2.english: They are not combined - Since they contradict each other regarding the essential substance of the testimony.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:26:1.hebrew: וארנקי שחורה - דלאו בעיקר גוף העדות מתכחשי, דכוותיה בדיני נפשות לא? בתמיה:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:26:1.english: And a black purse - [In a case] where they do not contradict each other regarding the essential core of the testimony, is [testimony] like it not [valid] in capital cases?! [This is asked] in astonishment.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:26:2.english: With an ariran - [This is] a guisarme [a type of polearm], in Old French.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:26:3.hebrew: אין זה נכון - אין עדות זו מכוונת, ולישנא דקרא נקט: "והנה אמת נכון הדבר" (דברים י״ג:ט״ו), דמהאי קרא נפקא לן בדיקות (לקמן סנהדרין מ:):
Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:26:3.english: This is not congruent - This testimony is not aligned, and he adopted the language of the verse: “And behold, the thing is true and certain” (Deuteronomy 13:15), as from this verse we derive examinations (below, Sanhedrin 40b).

Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:2:1.english: Was striving - Anticipating, seeking, and striving diligently to ordain him.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:3:1.hebrew: דין ידע - זה יודע, ורבי יוסי בר' חנינא היה:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:3:1.english: This one knows - This [one] knows, and it was Rabbi Yosei, son of Rabbi Ḥanina.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:4:1.hebrew: שמודה ר' יהושע לר' נתן - דכי היכי דלא בעי ר' יהושע ראיה כי הדדי, הגדה נמי כי הדדי לא בעי:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:4:1.english: That Rabbi Yehoshua concedes to Rabbi Natan - That just as Rabbi Yehoshua does not require seeing [the event] together, so too he does not require testifying [in court] together.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:7:1.hebrew: בין בקרקעות - זה אומר: בפני הודה לו שקרקע זה שלו, וזה אומר: אף בפני הודה לו:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:7:1.english: Both with regard to land - This [witness] says: “In my presence he admitted to him that this land is his,” and that [witness] says: “Also in my presence he admitted to him.”

Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:7:2.hebrew: בין במטלטלין - זה אומר: בפני הלווהו מנה, וזה אומר: בפני הלווהו מנה. ואע"פ דאמנה דקמסהיד האי לא מסהיד האי, מ"מ תרווייהו מסהדי שחייב לו מנה:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:7:2.english: Both with regard to movable property - This [witness] says: "In my presence he lent him a maneh," and that [witness] says: "In my presence he lent him a maneh." And even though this [witness] is not testifying about the [same] maneh that that [witness] is testifying about, nevertheless, both of them testify that he owes him a maneh.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:8:1.hebrew: הלכה כמותו בקרקעות - שמוטל הקרקע בפנינו, ושניהם מעידין עליה:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:8:1.english: The halakha is in accordance with his view regarding land - For the land lies before us, and both [witnesses] testify about it.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:8:2.hebrew: אבל לא במטלטלין - דאין עדות שלימה, לא על זה ולא על זה:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:8:2.english: But not with regard to movable property - For there is no complete testimony, neither about this [item] nor about that [item].

Rashi on Sanhedrin 30b:9:1.english: By inference that they disagree - The Rabbis disagree with him regarding land.

Tosafot on Sanhedrin 30b:10:1.hebrew: בעדות בכור - פי': ששמעו מאביו זה אחר זה, "איש פלוני בן בכור הוא". ודלא כפי' הקונטרס, דפירש לענין מום הראוי לבא בידי אדם, שנחשדו הכהנים, דנאמן זה לומר "מעצמו נפל מום זה" וחבירו על מום אחר; דא"כ, למה לי ב' עדים? אפי' יחיד נאמן, ואפי' עד מפי עד, כדאי' בפ' כל פסולי המוקדשים (בכורות דף לו.) ובפרק חבית (שבת דף קמה:):
Tosafot on Sanhedrin 30b:10:1.english: With regard to testimony concerning a firstborn - Explanation: [This means] that they heard from his father, one after the other, "So-and-so, [my] son, is a firstborn." And [this is] not like the explanation of Rashi, who explained [it] regarding a blemish capable of being caused by human hands, in which the priests were suspected [of causing blemishes intentionally], where this [witness] is believed to say, "This blemish occurred on its own," and his fellow [witness testifies] concerning another blemish; for if so, why do I need two witnesses? Even an individual is believed, and even a witness [testifying] from the mouth of [another] witness, as it is stated in the chapter [entitled] Kol P'sulei HaMukdashin (Bekhorot 36a) and in the chapter [entitled] Chavit (Shabbat 145b).
